message.content: Dyllan describes the combat in "Horizon Forbidden West" as being both diverse and challenging, with a wide range of environments and enemies to face. He appreciates how the environments bring different challenges, noting that the diversity is what makes the game engaging. However, he also mentions that the combat can be tricky at times, particularly dealing with flying machines, which requires careful maneuvers and strategic thinking. Dyllan emphasizes the convenience of the Control Center for adjusting audio settings on the fly, which he finds very useful during intense action sequences.
